text: sorry I don't really know if this is the right number but my mum's on a night shift and I can't get hold of her and I'm looking after my baby sister. she's 5 months old. she felt really hot so I found the thermometer in the bathroom drawer and did it under her arm like it says on the box and it said 38.1.
